method: Command-enabled local inspection, independent JSON parsing, raw-byte hashing, immutable-baseline comparison and executable contract validation.

checks.check: Exactly eleven required append-only candidate paths are present and no CC-002 review or approval artifact exists.
checks.command: Get-ChildItem 'cases\Stratton-Europe-Captital\3-azure-design' -Recurse -File | Where-Object Name -Like '*cc-002*'; Test-Path the two round-6 review paths and two CC-002 approval paths

checks.check: Markdown contains the thirteen required H2 sections and exact three-row model-role table.
HTML is self-contained, reproduces thirteen sections and tables, and includes responsive and print CSS.
checks.command: $html=Get-Content -Raw <amendment.html>; count <h2>; detect external script src; detect responsive and print media rules

checks.check: Every candidate JSON parses independently to an object.
checks.command: Get-ChildItem 'cases\Stratton-Europe-Captital\3-azure-design' -Recurse -File | Where-Object Name -Like '*cc-002*.json' | ForEach-Object { Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $_.FullName | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 100 }

checks.check: Portfolio contains typed deployment, capability, API, specialist and owner-bound records without token-dump shortcuts.
checks.command: PowerShell ConvertFrom-Json typed-property assertions over the portfolio contract

checks.check: Routing contract contains exactly eight fixed routes and five ordered escalation reasons.
checks.command: PowerShell typed-property counts plus Phase 3 contract

checks.check: Evaluation contract encodes the exact benchmark and all approved quality and performance thresholds.
checks.command: PowerShell typed-property counts plus Phase 3 contract

observed.benchmarkMinimum: 100 representative generative cases per promoted route

checks.check: Security contract retains private networking, managed identity, provider no-training use, prompt-injection controls, citation validation, fail-closed fallback and human authority.
checks.command: PowerShell typed-property assertions plus Phase 3 contract

checks.check: All ten non-manifest candidate digests match exact raw bytes and manifest paths are repository-relative ordinal sorted.
checks.command: $manifest=Get-Content -Raw <manifest>|ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 100; compare each sha256 with Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 and compare path order

checks.check: Five immutable Phase 3 sources match Task 1 baseline bytes and SHA-256 evidence.
checks.command: Compare live and baseline Get-FileHash SHA256 values from task-01-manifest.json

limitations: No Azure sign-in, Azure validation, what-if, deployment or runtime test was performed.
No AFF-A or AFF-B record and no approval record was created.
The candidate remains mutable until formal hash-bound review starts.
